messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] re: import ultrasome to chromosomeExplorer

On Mon, Mar 1, 2010 at 12:45 AM, seth redmond
<seth.r...@imperial.ac.uk> wrote:
> I'm trying to view some segments I've got from ultrasome in the chromosome
> explorer, but I can only find vignettes to fit CBS models. Is there an easy
> way to import these values and view them within the CE?

The current implementation of ChromosomeExplorer class/framework
doesn't allow you to *import* external segmentation results and
overlay them in the plots.

A better alternative would be to setup a UltrasomeModel class, similar
to CbsModel etc, that does Ultrasome segmentation. The "challenge"
for doing this is actually only to setup a low-level
segmentByUltrasome() function that takes the CN data, wraps in up in a
format recognized by Ultrasome, calls Ultrasome, retrieves/parses the
segmentation results and return it as an R object.
For the coding savvy willing to spend an afternoon or so this is not
that hard. Really good templates are segmentByCBS(), segmentByGLAD(),
segmentByHaarSeg() for the RawGenomicSignals class, see the
corresponding RawGenomicSignals.segmentBy*.R source files in the
aroma.core package.

Since Ultrasome is currently only available as an external binary, the
best way to "calls Ultrasome" is to have another low-level ultrasome()
method that calls the Ultrasome binaries via a system() call.

I can add it to my todo list, but that's very long, so it is unlikely
to happen before I need it myself.
